edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. At Closing, the Buyer shall pay the Seller the purchase price agreed in writing by the parties (the “Purchase Price”) in immediately available funds against delivery of the Shares. The parties shall confirm the Purchase Price in a signed writing before Closing.
edits.name: purchase_price

edits.text: 3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents that, to the Seller’s knowledge, the financial statements delivered to the Buyer fairly present, in all material respects, the financial position of the business for the periods stated, subject to any exceptions disclosed in writing to the Buyer before signing.
edits.name: representations

edits.text: 4. INDEMNITY. The Seller shall indemnify the Buyer against losses arising from liabilities of the business existing before Closing that were not disclosed in writing to the Buyer before signing, except to the extent reflected in the Purchase Price or otherwise recovered by the Buyer. The parties shall agree in writing on applicable claim procedures, survival periods, and liability limits before signing.
edits.name: indemnity

edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The purchase price for the Shares is USD [INSERT AGREED AMOUNT] (the “Purchase Price”). At Closing, the Buyer shall pay the Purchase Price in immediately available funds against delivery of the Shares. The parties shall complete the Purchase Price in this Agreement before signing; neither party is bound to close under an agreement that does not state the Purchase Price.
edits.name: Purchase Price

edits.text: 3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents that the financial statements delivered to the Buyer fairly present, in all material respects, the financial position of the business for the periods stated.
edits.name: Representations

edits.text: 4. INDEMNITY. The Seller shall indemnify the Buyer against losses, damages, liabilities, and reasonable out-of-pocket costs (including reasonable attorneys’ fees) arising from (a) a breach of the Seller’s representations or covenants in this Agreement or (b) liabilities of the business existing before Closing, except to the extent such losses are reflected in the Purchase Price or otherwise recovered by the Buyer. The Buyer shall give the Seller written notice of a claim, with reasonable detail, within 18 months after Closing; a claim timely noticed may be resolved after that period. The Seller may assume the defense of a third-party claim using counsel reasonably acceptable to the Buyer, but may not settle a claim without the Buyer’s written consent unless the settlement provides a full release of the Buyer, imposes no nonmonetary obligation on the Buyer, and requires payment solely by the Seller. The Buyer may participate through its own counsel at its own expense, except that the Seller shall pay reasonable counsel fees if an actual conflict of interest requires separate counsel. The Buyer shall reasonably cooperate in the defense at the Seller’s expense and shall take reasonable steps to mitigate its losses. The Seller’s aggregate liability under this Section shall not exceed 20% of the Purchase Price, except for fraud or willful misconduct, for which this limit and the 18-month notice period do not apply. The Buyer shall not recover more than once for the same loss.
edits.name: Indemnity
